RFP Release 

HPD released the New Utrecht Library and Affordable Housing Request for Proposals (RFP) on June 10, 2026. HPD and BPL invite developers to submit proposals for the redevelopment of New Utrecht Library in Brooklyn with a new state-of-the-art library alongside 100 percent affordable housing.  An online pre-submission conference was held on Wednesday, July 1, 2026. Submissions were due on September 4, 2026.

Inquiries  

All communications must be made in writingto NewUtrechtLibrary@hpd.nyc.gov.
